method: Sustained180-second duration-weighted CPU/memory/backing-device headroom, then two fresh15-second acceptable samples before each job; ongoing monitoring and process-group watchdogs.

qualification.method: Duration-weighted sustained headroom with bounded peaks, no observed userspace D threads or memory pressure, followed by two fresh acceptable samples. Raw PSI/iowait retains unresolved provenance.

backingStorage: Repository/output and Docker data on btrfs subvolumes on nvme0n1p5; /tmp and owned PostgreSQL data tmpfs.
limitation: Raw global I/O PSI/iowait remains elevated with unresolved provenance. No graphics-causality, zero-pressure or production-percentile claim. Competing work was neither stopped nor reused.
watchdogs: nice10/ionice2priority7,15minutes per job (bulk30minutes),10second TERM-to-KILL grace; browser/build owners never overlap.
